Signed-off-by: bzsuni <bingzhe.sun@daocloud.io>

     {"object":"error","message":"Model \"BAAI/bge-m3\" does not support matryoshka representation, changing output dimensions will lead to poor results.","type":"BadRequestError","param":null,"code":400}
     ```
 
+For supported models, `dimensions` must not exceed the model's output embedding size, which can differ from its hidden size. For example, `voyageai/voyage-4-nano` supports `dimensions=2048` even though its hidden size is 1024. Models with `matryoshka_dimensions` also restrict requests to the listed values.
+
 #### Manually enable Matryoshka Embeddings
 
 There is currently no official interface for specifying support for Matryoshka Embeddings. In vLLM, if `is_matryoshka` is `True` in `config.json`, you can change the output dimension to arbitrary values. Use `matryoshka_dimensions` to control the allowed output dimensions.

+def mm_dtype_batch_invariant(a, b, out_dtype, *, out=None):

+def _input_embeds(hf_model, model: str, prompts: list[str]) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """Prompt embeddings for the vLLM inputs_embeds path, off the HF model."""
+    embeds = []
+    for prompt in prompts:
+        token_ids = hf_model.tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt").input_ids.to(
+            hf_model.model.device
+        )
+        # Retained prompt values must not keep reference weights alive.
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            embed = hf_model.model.get_input_embeddings()(token_ids)
+
+        # MiniCPM models apply scale_emb to embeddings internally.
+        # vLLM expects pre-scaled embeddings when using inputs_embeds.
+        if model in EMBED_SCALING_MODELS:
+            embed = embed * hf_model.model.config.scale_emb
+

+    return embeds

+}

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", [TRAINING_EXPORT, TRANSFORMERS_NATIVE])

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Inference-only LFM3-Audio model: speech in, text out.
+
+The speech output head (codebook embedding, depth decoder) is not served and its
+weights are skipped on load.
+"""
+
+import copy
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
+from typing import Annotated, Literal, TypeAlias
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from transformers import BatchFeature, Lfm2Model
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.config.multimodal import MultiModalDummyOptions
+from vllm.inputs import MultiModalDataDict
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils import (
+    MambaStateCopyFunc,
+    MambaStateCopyFuncCalculator,
+)
+from vllm.multimodal import MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY
+from vllm.multimodal.inputs import MultiModalFieldConfig, MultiModalKwargsItems
+from vllm.multimodal.parse import MultiModalDataItems, MultiModalDataParser
+from vllm.multimodal.processing import (
+    BaseDummyInputsBuilder,
+    BaseMultiModalProcessor,
+    BaseProcessingInfo,
+    PromptReplacement,
+    PromptUpdate,
+)
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.lfm3_audio import (
+    Lfm3AudioConfig,
+    Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig,
+)
+from vllm.transformers_utils.processors.lfm3_audio import (
+    Lfm3AudioFeatureExtractor,
+    Lfm3AudioProcessor,
+)
+from vllm.utils.tensor_schema import TensorSchema, TensorShape
+
+from .interfaces import (
+    HasInnerState,
+    IsHybrid,
+    MultiModalEmbeddings,
+    SupportsMultiModal,
+    SupportsPP,
+)
+from .lfm3 import _short_conv_state_dtype, _short_conv_state_shape
+from .utils import (
+    AutoWeightsLoader,
+    WeightsMapper,
+    init_vllm_registered_model,
+    maybe_prefix,
+)
+
+# Bounds the profiling run and the encoder cache (one token per 80 ms); the
+# encoder itself is causal with a bounded window, so any length runs.
+MAX_AUDIO_SECONDS = 600
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioFeatureInputs(TensorSchema):
+    """Dimensions:
+    - na: Number of audios
+    - nmb: Number of mel bins
+    - nf: Number of spectrogram frames
+    """
+
+    type: Literal["audio_features"]
+    input_features: Annotated[
+        torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor],
+        TensorShape("na", "nmb", "nf", dynamic_dims={"nf"}),
+    ]
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioEmbeddingInputs(TensorSchema):
+    """Dimensions:
+    - na: Number of audios
+    - nt: Number of audio tokens
+    - hs: Hidden size of the language model
+    """
+
+    type: Literal["audio_embeds"]
+    audio_embeds: Annotated[
+        torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor],
+        TensorShape("na", "nt", "hs", dynamic_dims={"nt"}),
+    ]
+
+
+Lfm3AudioInputs: TypeAlias = Lfm3AudioFeatureInputs | Lfm3AudioEmbeddingInputs
+
+
+def split_audio_features(processed_data: BatchFeature) -> BatchFeature:
+    """Keeps each clip's own frames: the features are padded to the longest clip
+    of the call, so cached and freshly processed items would differ."""
+    if (masks := processed_data.pop("feature_attention_mask", None)) is not None:
+        processed_data["input_features"] = [
+            features[..., :length]
+            for features, length in zip(
+                processed_data["input_features"], masks.sum(-1).tolist()
+            )
+        ]
+    return processed_data
+
+
+def suppress_speech_mode(
+    config: Lfm3AudioConfig, logits: torch.Tensor | None
+) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    # These tokens switch generation to speech, whose output head is not served.
+    if logits is not None:
+        logits[..., config.audio_start_token_id] = float("-inf")
+        logits[..., config.mixed_start_token_id] = float("-inf")
+    return logits
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioDownsampler(nn.Module):
+    """Three stride-2 convolutions over the (mel, time) plane: 128 mel bins and
+    8 frames become one vector."""
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        channels = config.conv_channels
+        conv = {"kernel_size": 3, "stride": 2, "padding": 1}
+        self.conv_in = nn.Conv2d(1, channels, **conv)
+        self.conv_mid = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, groups=channels, **conv)
+        self.lin_mid = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, kernel_size=1)
+        self.conv_end = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, groups=channels, **conv)
+        self.lin_end = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, kernel_size=1)
+        self.lin_out = nn.Conv1d(
+            config.num_mel_bins * channels // 8,
+            config.text_config.hidden_size,
+            kernel_size=1,
+        )
+        self.act = nn.SiLU()
+
+    def forward(self, input_features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = self.act(self.conv_in(input_features.unsqueeze(1)))
+        hidden_states = self.act(self.lin_mid(self.conv_mid(hidden_states)))
+        hidden_states = self.act(self.lin_end(self.conv_end(hidden_states)))
+        return self.lin_out(hidden_states.flatten(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioEncoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config: Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.sliding_window = config.sliding_window
+        self.downsample = Lfm3AudioDownsampler(config)
+        lfm_config = copy.deepcopy(config.text_config)
+        lfm_config._attn_implementation = "sdpa"
+        self.lfm = Lfm2Model(lfm_config)
+        # The encoder consumes spectrogram features only
+        self.lfm.embed_tokens = None
+
+    def forward(self, input_features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = self.downsample(input_features)
+        positions = torch.arange(hidden_states.shape[1], device=hidden_states.device)
+        distance = positions[:, None] - positions[None, :]
+        mask = (distance >= 0) & (distance < self.sliding_window)
+        return self.lfm(
+            inputs_embeds=hidden_states,
+            attention_mask={"full_attention": mask[None, None], "conv": None},
+            use_cache=False,
+        ).last_hidden_state
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioProjector(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config: Lfm3AudioConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        in_features = config.audio_encoder_config.text_config.hidden_size
+        out_features = config.text_config.hidden_size
+        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(in_features)
+        self.linear_1 = ReplicatedLinear(
+            in_features,
+            out_features,
+            return_bias=False,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear_1"),
+        )
+        self.act = nn.GELU()
+        self.linear_2 = ReplicatedLinear(
+            out_features,
+            out_features,
+            return_bias=False,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear_2"),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, audio_features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = self.linear_1(self.layer_norm(audio_features))
+        return self.linear_2(self.act(hidden_states))
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioProcessingInfo(BaseProcessingInfo):
+    def get_hf_config(self) -> Lfm3AudioConfig:
+        return self.ctx.get_hf_config(Lfm3AudioConfig)
+
+    def get_hf_processor(self, **kwargs: object) -> Lfm3AudioProcessor:
+        return self.ctx.get_hf_processor(Lfm3AudioProcessor, **kwargs)
+
+    def get_feature_extractor(self, **kwargs: object) -> Lfm3AudioFeatureExtractor:
+        return self.get_hf_processor(**kwargs).feature_extractor
+
+    def get_data_parser(self) -> MultiModalDataParser:
+        return MultiModalDataParser(
+            target_sr=self.get_feature_extractor().sampling_rate,
+            target_channels=1,
+            expected_hidden_size=self._get_expected_hidden_size(),
+            allow_missing_mm_embeddings=self.allow_missing_mm_embeddings,
+        )
+
+    def get_supported_mm_limits(self) -> Mapping[str, int | None]:
+        return {"audio": None}
+
+    def get_max_audio_samples(self) -> int:
+        return MAX_AUDIO_SECONDS * self.get_feature_extractor().sampling_rate
+
+    def get_mm_max_tokens_per_item(
+        self, seq_len: int, mm_counts: Mapping[str, int] | None = None
+    ) -> Mapping[str, int]:
+        extractor = self.get_feature_extractor()
+        num_frames = extractor.num_frames(self.get_max_audio_samples())
+        return {"audio": extractor.num_encoder_tokens(num_frames)}
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioDummyInputsBuilder(BaseDummyInputsBuilder[Lfm3AudioProcessingInfo]):
+    def get_dummy_text(self, mm_counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> str:
+        return self.info.get_hf_processor().audio_token * mm_counts.get("audio", 0)
+
+    def get_dummy_mm_data(
+        self,
+        seq_len: int,
+        mm_counts: Mapping[str, int],
+        mm_options: MultiModalDummyOptions,
+    ) -> MultiModalDataDict:
+        return {
+            "audio": self._get_dummy_audios(
+                length=self.info.get_max_audio_samples(),
+                num_audios=mm_counts.get("audio", 0),
+                overrides=mm_options.get("audio"),
+            )
+        }
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioMultiModalProcessor(BaseMultiModalProcessor[Lfm3AudioProcessingInfo]):
+    def _postprocess_hf_mm_data(
+        self,
+        mm_inputs: Mapping[str, object],
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs: Mapping[str, object],
+        processed_data: BatchFeature,
+    ) -> BatchFeature:
+        return split_audio_features(processed_data)
+
+    def _get_mm_fields_config(
+        self, hf_inputs: BatchFeature, hf_processor_mm_kwargs: Mapping[str, object]
+    ) -> Mapping[str, MultiModalFieldConfig]:
+        return {
+            "input_features": MultiModalFieldConfig.batched("audio"),
+            "audio_embeds": MultiModalFieldConfig.batched("audio"),
+        }
+
+    def _get_prompt_updates(
+        self,
+        mm_items: MultiModalDataItems,
+        hf_processor_mm_kwargs: Mapping[str, object],
+        out_mm_kwargs: MultiModalKwargsItems,
+    ) -> Sequence[PromptUpdate]:
+        processor = self.info.get_hf_processor(**hf_processor_mm_kwargs)
+        extractor = processor.feature_extractor
+
+        def audio_tokens(item_idx: int) -> list[int]:
+            item = out_mm_kwargs["audio"][item_idx]
+            if (embeds := item.get("audio_embeds")) is not None:
+                count = len(embeds.data)
+            else:
+                features = item["input_features"].data
+                assert isinstance(features, torch.Tensor)
+                count = extractor.num_encoder_tokens(features.shape[-1])
+            return [processor.audio_token_id] * count
+
+        return [PromptReplacement("audio", [processor.audio_token_id], audio_tokens)]
+
+
+@MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.register_processor(

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+from typing import Any
+
+from transformers import Lfm2Config, PreTrainedConfig
+
+from .lfm3 import Lfm3Config
+
+
+def _lfm2_config(values: dict[str, Any]) -> Lfm2Config:
+    values = dict(values)
+    # The training export stores the encoder as LFM2; the transformers-native
+    # export as an LFM3 stack without the attention gate and sandwich norms,
+    # which is the same network.
+    if values.pop("model_type", "lfm2") == "lfm3":
+        (values["rope_parameters"],) = values["rope_parameters"].values()
+        values["layer_types"] = [
+            "full_attention" if layer_type == "sliding_attention" else layer_type
+            for layer_type in values["layer_types"]
+        ]
+        values["block_auto_adjust_ff_dim"] = False
+    values.pop("dtype", None)
+    return Lfm2Config(**values)
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig(PreTrainedConfig):
+    model_type = "lfm3_audio_encoder"
+    sub_configs = {"text_config": Lfm2Config}
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        text_config: dict | Lfm2Config | None = None,
+        num_mel_bins: int = 128,
+        conv_channels: int = 256,
+        sliding_window: int | None = None,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        num_mel_bins = kwargs.pop("dim_in", num_mel_bins)
+        conv_channels = kwargs.pop("dim_conv", conv_channels)
+        backbone = kwargs.pop("lfm", text_config)
+        if isinstance(backbone, dict):
+            sliding_window = sliding_window or backbone.get("sliding_window")
+            backbone = _lfm2_config(backbone)
+        self.text_config: Lfm2Config = backbone or Lfm2Config()
+        self.num_mel_bins = num_mel_bins
+        self.conv_channels = conv_channels
+        # Past frames each frame attends to, itself included
+        self.sliding_window = sliding_window or 32
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioConfig(PreTrainedConfig):
+    model_type = "lfm3_audio"
+    sub_configs = {
+        "text_config": Lfm3Config,
+        "audio_encoder_config": Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig,
+    }
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        text_config: dict | Lfm3Config | None = None,
+        audio_encoder_config: dict | Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig | None = None,
+        audio_token_id: int = 125_031,
+        audio_start_token_id: int = 125_012,
+        mixed_start_token_id: int = 125_015,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        # The hub checkpoints keep the training export's `lfm` / `encoder` keys
+        text_config = kwargs.pop("lfm", text_config)
+        audio_encoder_config = kwargs.pop("encoder", audio_encoder_config)
+        self.text_config: Lfm3Config = (
+            Lfm3Config(**text_config)
+            if isinstance(text_config, dict)
+            else text_config or Lfm3Config()
+        )
+        self.audio_encoder_config: Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig = (
+            Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig(**audio_encoder_config)
+            if isinstance(audio_encoder_config, dict)
+            else audio_encoder_config or Lfm3AudioEncoderConfig()
+        )
+        self.audio_token_id = audio_token_id
+        self.audio_start_token_id = audio_start_token_id
+        self.mixed_start_token_id = mixed_start_token_id
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer, BatchFeature
+from transformers.audio_utils import mel_filter_bank
+from transformers.feature_extraction_sequence_utils import SequenceFeatureExtractor
+from transformers.processing_utils import ProcessorMixin
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioFeatureExtractor(SequenceFeatureExtractor):
+    """Log-mel spectrogram without centering, right-padded to whole frames;
+    every `encoder_stride` frames become one encoder token."""
+
+    model_input_names = ["input_features", "feature_attention_mask"]
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        feature_size: int = 128,
+        sampling_rate: int = 16000,
+        n_fft: int = 400,
+        hop_length: int = 160,
+        win_length: int = 400,
+        log_floor: float = -12.0,
+        normalization_offset: float = 4.0,
+        normalization_divisor: float = 4.0,
+        encoder_stride: int = 8,
+        padding_value: float = 0.0,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            feature_size=feature_size,
+            sampling_rate=sampling_rate,
+            padding_value=padding_value,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        self.n_fft = n_fft
+        self.hop_length = hop_length
+        self.win_length = win_length
+        self.log_floor = log_floor
+        self.normalization_offset = normalization_offset
+        self.normalization_divisor = normalization_divisor
+        self.encoder_stride = encoder_stride
+        self.mel_filters = mel_filter_bank(
+            num_frequency_bins=n_fft // 2 + 1,
+            num_mel_filters=feature_size,
+            min_frequency=0.0,
+            max_frequency=sampling_rate / 2,
+            sampling_rate=sampling_rate,
+            norm="slaney",
+            mel_scale="slaney",
+        )
+
+    def num_frames(self, num_samples: int) -> int:
+        return 1 + (self._padded_length(num_samples) - self.n_fft) // self.hop_length
+
+    def num_encoder_tokens(self, num_frames: int) -> int:
+        return -(num_frames // -self.encoder_stride)
+
+    def _padded_length(self, num_samples: int) -> int:
+        if num_samples < self.n_fft:
+            return self.n_fft
+        return num_samples + (-(num_samples - self.n_fft) % self.hop_length)
+
+    def _log_mel(self, waveform: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        waveform = torch.nn.functional.pad(
+            waveform, (0, self._padded_length(len(waveform)) - len(waveform))
+        )
+        spectrogram = torch.stft(
+            waveform,
+            n_fft=self.n_fft,
+            hop_length=self.hop_length,
+            win_length=self.win_length,
+            window=torch.hann_window(self.win_length),
+            center=False,
+            return_complex=True,
+        )
+        power = spectrogram.abs().square()
+        mel_filters = torch.from_numpy(self.mel_filters).to(power.dtype)
+        log_mel = (mel_filters.T @ power).log10().clamp(min=self.log_floor)
+        return (log_mel + self.normalization_offset) / self.normalization_divisor
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        raw_speech: np.ndarray | list[np.ndarray],
+        sampling_rate: int | None = None,
+        return_tensors: str | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> BatchFeature:
+        if isinstance(raw_speech, np.ndarray) and raw_speech.ndim == 1:
+            raw_speech = [raw_speech]
+        features = [
+            self._log_mel(torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(clip, dtype=np.float32)))
+            for clip in raw_speech
+        ]
+        max_length = max(feature.shape[-1] for feature in features)
+        input_features = torch.full(
+            (len(features), self.feature_size, max_length), self.padding_value
+        )
+        feature_attention_mask = torch.zeros(
+            (len(features), max_length), dtype=torch.long
+        )
+        for index, feature in enumerate(features):
+            input_features[index, :, : feature.shape[-1]] = feature
+            feature_attention_mask[index, : feature.shape[-1]] = 1
+        return BatchFeature(
+            {
+                "input_features": input_features,
+                "feature_attention_mask": feature_attention_mask,
+            },
+            tensor_type=return_tensors,
+        )
+
+
+class Lfm3AudioProcessor(ProcessorMixin):
+    @classmethod
+    def from_pretrained(cls, pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs):
+        # The hub processor also loads the speech codec, which only speech
+        # output needs.
+        tokenizer = kwargs.pop("tokenizer", None)
+        if tokenizer is None:
+            tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
+                pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs
+            )
+        feature_extractor = Lfm3AudioFeatureExtractor.from_pretrained(
+            pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs
+        )
+        return cls(feature_extractor=feature_extractor, tokenizer=tokenizer)
+
+    def __init__(self, feature_extractor, tokenizer, audio_token: str = "<|audio|>"):
+        super().__init__(feature_extractor, tokenizer)
+        self.audio_token = audio_token
+        self.audio_token_id = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(audio_token)
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        text: str | list[str] | None = None,
+        audio: np.ndarray | list[np.ndarray] | None = None,
+        return_tensors: str | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> BatchFeature:
+        # vLLM expands the audio placeholders itself, so text is only tokenized
+        data = {}
+        if audio is not None:

+class MockBase:

-  # Handle architecture-specific suffixes (a/f) for SRC entries.
-  # First try exact base match (x.y), then cross-suffix match (x.ya / x.yf).
-  # For 'f' (family) suffix: if no exact/cross match, fall back to major-version
-  # match — e.g. SRC="12.0f" matches TGT="12.1a" since SM121 is in the SM12x
-  # family. The output uses TGT's value to preserve the user's compilation flags.
+  # Handle architecture-specific suffixes (a/f) for SRC entries. Each step runs
+  # over all SRC entries before the next, so a family fallback never takes a
+  # TGT entry that another SRC entry matches by name:
+  #  1. exact base match: TGT has x.y, output SRC's x.ya / x.yf;
+  #  2. cross-suffix match: TGT has x.ya (preferred) or x.yf, output that;
+  #  3. family fallback ('f' only): x.yf code never runs on a lower minor, so
+  #     take the first remaining TGT entry with the same major and a version
+  #     >= x.y, highest x.y first (an approximation of the CUDA family table).
+  #     E.g. SRC="12.0f" matches TGT="12.1a". The output uses TGT's value to
+  #     preserve the user's compilation flags.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Bit-exact parity of the fused state gather/scatter kernels with eager."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_cuda():
+    pytest.skip(
+        reason="The fused state gather/scatter kernels are Triton/CUDA.",
+        allow_module_level=True,
+    )
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.gather_initial_states import (  # noqa: E402
+    gather_initial_states,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.scatter_states import (  # noqa: E402
+    scatter_states,
+)
+
+# A small GDN-like state: (slots, heads, rows, cols).
+SLOTS, HEADS, ROWS, COLS = 512 + 3, 4, 128, 128
+
+
+def _make(batch, pool_dtype, strided, gen):
+    # Mamba pages may pad the row stride; build the pool over padded storage.
+    row_size = HEADS * ROWS * COLS
+    storage = torch.randn(SLOTS, row_size + 256, dtype=pool_dtype, device="cuda")
+    pool = storage[:, :row_size].view(SLOTS, HEADS, ROWS, COLS)
+    assert not pool.is_contiguous() and pool[0].is_contiguous()
+    has = torch.rand(batch, device="cuda", generator=gen) < 0.5
+    if strided:
+        # Spec-decode block table: rows hold 1 + num_spec state slots, so
+        # column 0 is a strided view (degenerate but valid at batch == 1).
+        table = torch.randperm(SLOTS, device="cuda", generator=gen)[: 2 * batch]
+        indices = table.view(batch, 2).to(torch.int32)[:, 0]
+        assert batch == 1 or not indices.is_contiguous()
+    else:
+        indices = torch.randperm(SLOTS, device="cuda", generator=gen)[:batch].to(
+            torch.int32
+        )
+    return pool, indices, has
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("strided", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [1, 3, 64, 256])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("pool_dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16])
+def test_gather_correctness(pool_dtype, batch, strided):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    pool, indices, has = _make(batch, pool_dtype, strided, gen)
+
+    want = pool[indices]
+    want[~has] = 0
+    got = gather_initial_states(pool, indices, has)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got, want, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("strided", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [1, 3, 64, 256])

+        (torch.bfloat16, torch.bfloat16),
+        (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32),
+    ],

+    @contextmanager
+    def evict_after_stat():
+        stat_done = threading.Event()

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding.common import ApplyRotaryEmb
+from vllm.multimodal import MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.lfm3_vl import Lfm3VlConfig, Lfm3VlVisionConfig
+from vllm.transformers_utils.processors.lfm3_vl import Lfm3VlProcessor
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+

+    HasInnerState,
+    IsHybrid,
+    MultiModalEmbeddings,
+    SupportsMultiModal,
+    SupportsPP,
+)
+from .lfm3 import Lfm3MLP, _short_conv_state_dtype, _short_conv_state_shape
+from .qwen3_vl import (
+    Qwen3VLDummyInputsBuilder,
+    Qwen3VLMultiModalProcessor,
+    Qwen3VLProcessingInfo,
+)
+from .utils import (
+    AutoWeightsLoader,
+    WeightsMapper,
+    init_vllm_registered_model,
+    maybe_prefix,
+)
+from .vision import get_fp8_padded_hidden_size, get_vit_attn_backend
+
+
+class Lfm3VlVisionAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Bidirectional grouped-query attention over the patches of one frame, with
+    RMSNorm on the query and key heads and axial 2D RoPE."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Lfm3VlVisionConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.head_dim = config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            config.num_attention_heads,
+            config.num_key_value_heads,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.num_heads = self.qkv_proj.num_heads
+        self.num_kv_heads = self.qkv_proj.num_kv_heads
+        self.out_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            config.num_attention_heads * self.head_dim,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.out_proj",
+        )
+        self.q_layernorm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.norm_eps)
+        self.k_layernorm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, eps=config.norm_eps)
+        self.apply_rotary_emb = ApplyRotaryEmb(enforce_enable=True)
+        self.attn = MMEncoderAttention(
+            num_heads=self.num_heads,
+            head_size=self.head_dim,
+            scale=self.head_dim**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        max_seqlen: torch.Tensor,
+        cos: torch.Tensor,
+        sin: torch.Tensor,
+        sequence_lengths: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        seq_len = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([q_size, kv_size, kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q = self.q_layernorm(q.reshape(seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim))
+        k = self.k_layernorm(k.reshape(seq_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim))
+        v = v.reshape(1, seq_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        q = self.apply_rotary_emb(q[None], cos, sin)
+        k = self.apply_rotary_emb(k[None], cos, sin)
+        if self.attn.attn_backend == AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER:
+            # The cuDNN wrapper shares physical offsets between Q, K and O, so
+            # K and V take the query head count and V the same contiguous layout.
+            if self.num_kv_heads != self.num_heads:
+                repeats = self.num_heads // self.num_kv_heads
+                k = k.repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=2)
+                v = v.repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=2)
+            v = v.contiguous()
+        output = self.attn(
+            query=q,
+            key=k,
+            value=v,
+            cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+            max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
+            sequence_lengths=sequence_lengths,
+        )
+        output, _ = self.out_proj(output.reshape(seq_len, -1))
+        return output
+
+
+class Lfm3VlVisionConv2d(nn.Module):
+    """Gated depthwise 2D convolution over the patch grid of each frame."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Lfm3VlVisionConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        dim = config.hidden_size
+        self.spatial_merge_size = config.spatial_merge_size
+        self.kernel_size = config.conv_kernel_size
+        self.in_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            dim,
+            [dim] * 3,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.in_proj",
+        )
+        # One (k, k) filter per channel, sharded over channels with the
+        # projections; the parameter keeps the Conv2d weight shape for loading.
+        self.spatial_conv = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            self.kernel_size**2, dim, bias=False, prefix=f"{prefix}.spatial_conv"
+        )
+        self.spatial_conv.weight.data = self.spatial_conv.weight.data.view(
+            -1, 1, self.kernel_size, self.kernel_size
+        )
+        self.out_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            dim, dim, bias=False, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.out_proj"
+        )
+
+    def _convolve(self, frames: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return F.conv2d(
+            frames,
+            self.spatial_conv.weight,
+            padding=self.kernel_size // 2,
+            groups=frames.shape[1],
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, frame_shapes: list[tuple[int, int]]
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        BCx, _ = self.in_proj(hidden_states)
+        B, C, x = BCx.chunk(3, dim=-1)
+        gated = B * x
+        merge = self.spatial_merge_size
+        if len(set(frame_shapes)) == 1:
+            # frames of one shape convolve as one batch: merge-block order ->
+            # raster grid, convolve, back
+            height, width = frame_shapes[0]
+            frames = gated.view(
+                len(frame_shapes), height // merge, width // merge, merge, merge, -1
+            )
+            frames = frames.permute(0, 5, 1, 3, 2, 4).reshape(
+                len(frame_shapes), -1, height, width
+            )
+            frames = self._convolve(frames)
+            frames = frames.view(
+                len(frame_shapes), -1, height // merge, merge, width // merge, merge
+            )
+            conv_output = frames.permute(0, 2, 4, 3, 5, 1).reshape(gated.shape[0], -1)
+        else:
+            outputs = []
+            lengths = [height * width for height, width in frame_shapes]
+            for frame, (height, width) in zip(gated.split(lengths), frame_shapes):
+                frame = frame.view(height // merge, width // merge, merge, merge, -1)
+                frame = frame.permute(4, 0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(1, -1, height, width)
+                frame = self._convolve(frame)
+                frame = frame.view(-1, height // merge, merge, width // merge, merge)
+                outputs.append(frame.permute(1, 3, 2, 4, 0).reshape(height * width, -1))
+            conv_output = torch.cat(outputs)
+        output, _ = self.out_proj(C * conv_output)
+        return output
+
+
+class Lfm3VlVisionLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Lfm3VlVisionConfig,
+        layer_idx: int,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.is_attention_layer = config.layer_types[layer_idx] == "full_attention"
+        if self.is_attention_layer:
+            self.self_attn = Lfm3VlVisionAttention(
+                config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn"
+            )
+        else:
+            self.conv = Lfm3VlVisionConv2d(
+                config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.conv"
+            )
+        self.feed_forward = Lfm3MLP(
+            config, quant_config=quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.feed_forward"
+        )
+        self.operator_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.norm_eps)
+        self.ffn_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.norm_eps)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        max_seqlen: torch.Tensor,
+        cos: torch.Tensor,
+        sin: torch.Tensor,
+        sequence_lengths: torch.Tensor | None,
+        frame_shapes: list[tuple[int, int]],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        normed = self.operator_norm(hidden_states)
+        if self.is_attention_layer:
+            operator_output = self.self_attn(
+                normed, cu_seqlens, max_seqlen, cos, sin, sequence_lengths
+            )
+        else:
+            operator_output = self.conv(normed, frame_shapes)
+        hidden_states = hidden_states + operator_output
+        return hidden_states + self.feed_forward(self.ffn_norm(hidden_states))
+
+
+class Lfm3VlVisionModel(nn.Module):
+    """The LFM3-VL vision encoder: gated convolution and bidirectional attention
+    layers over the patches of each image or video frame, embedded by a linear
+    patchifier."""
+
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_stacked={
+            ".q_proj.": (".qkv_proj.", "q"),
+            ".k_proj.": (".qkv_proj.", "k"),
+            ".v_proj.": (".qkv_proj.", "v"),
+            ".w1.": (".w13.", 0),
+            ".w3.": (".w13.", 1),
+        }
+    )
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Lfm3VlVisionConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.spatial_merge_size = config.spatial_merge_size
+        head_dim = config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads
+        patch_dim = (
+            config.in_channels * config.temporal_patch_size * config.patch_size**2
+        )
+        self.patchifier = ReplicatedLinear(
+            patch_dim,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.patchifier",
+        )
+        self.embedding_norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.norm_eps)
+        # Axial 2D RoPE: half the head rotates with the row, half with the column.
+        self.rotary_pos_emb = get_rope(
+            head_size=head_dim,
+            max_position=8192,
+            is_neox_style=True,
+            rope_parameters={
+                "partial_rotary_factor": 0.5,
+                "rope_theta": config.rope_parameters["rope_theta"],
+            },
+        )
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            Lfm3VlVisionLayer(
+                config,
+                layer_idx,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.layers.{layer_idx}",
+            )
+            for layer_idx in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
+        )
+        self.attn_backend = get_vit_attn_backend(
+            head_size=head_dim, dtype=torch.get_default_dtype()
+        )
+        # FlashInfer expands KV to the TP-local query head count before attention,
+        # so Q/K/V share one contiguous stride.
+        num_heads = divide(
+            config.num_attention_heads, get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        )
+        self.flashinfer_hidden_size = (
+            get_fp8_padded_hidden_size(num_heads, head_dim) or num_heads * head_dim
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def dtype(self) -> torch.dtype:
+        return self.patchifier.weight.dtype
+
+    @property
+    def device(self) -> torch.device:
+        return self.patchifier.weight.device
+
+    def position_embeddings(
+        self, grid_thw: list[list[int]]
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Cos and sin of every patch's (row, column), in merge-block order."""
+        merge = self.spatial_merge_size
+        positions = []
+        for t, h, w in grid_thw:
+            rows = torch.arange(h, device=self.device)[:, None].expand(h, w)
+            cols = torch.arange(w, device=self.device)[None, :].expand(h, w)
+            rows = rows.reshape(h // merge, merge, w // merge, merge).transpose(1, 2)
+            cols = cols.reshape(h // merge, merge, w // merge, merge).transpose(1, 2)
+            positions.append(
+                torch.stack([rows.flatten(), cols.flatten()], -1).repeat(t, 1)
+            )
+        positions = torch.cat(positions)
+        cos, sin = self.rotary_pos_emb.get_cos_sin(
+            max(max(h, w) for _, h, w in grid_thw)
+        )
+        return cos[positions].flatten(1), sin[positions].flatten(1)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, pixel_values: torch.Tensor, grid_thw: list[list[int]]
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states, _ = self.patchifier(pixel_values.to(self.device, self.dtype))
+        hidden_states = self.embedding_norm(hidden_states)
+        cos, sin = self.position_embeddings(grid_thw)
+        frame_shapes = [(h, w) for t, h, w in grid_thw for _ in range(t)]
+        cu_seqlens = np.cumsum([0] + [h * w for h, w in frame_shapes], dtype=np.int32)
+        max_seqlen = torch.tensor(
+            MMEncoderAttention.compute_max_seqlen(self.attn_backend, cu_seqlens),
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+        )
+        sequence_lengths = MMEncoderAttention.maybe_compute_seq_lens(
+            self.attn_backend, cu_seqlens, self.device
+        )
+        cu_seqlens = MMEncoderAttention.maybe_recompute_cu_seqlens(
+            self.attn_backend,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            hidden_size=hidden_states.shape[-1],
+            tp_size=1,  # flashinfer_hidden_size is already TP-local
+            device=self.device,
+            fp8_padded_hidden_size=self.flashinfer_hidden_size,
+        )
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states = layer(
+                hidden_states,
+                cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+                max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
+                cos=cos,
+                sin=sin,
+                sequence_lengths=sequence_lengths,
+                frame_shapes=frame_shapes,
+            )
+        return hidden_states
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        return AutoWeightsLoader(self).load_weights(
+            weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper
+        )
+
+
+class Lfm3VlMultiModalProjector(nn.Module):
+    """Merges each block of `spatial_merge_size**2` vision tokens, normalized
+    before the merge, into one language token."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Lfm3VlConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        vision_config = config.vision_config
+        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(vision_config.hidden_size, eps=1e-6)
+        self.linear_1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            vision_config.hidden_size * vision_config.spatial_merge_size**2,
+            config.projector_hidden_size,
+            bias=config.projector_bias,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.linear_1",
+        )
+        self.act = get_act_fn(config.projector_hidden_act)
+        self.linear_2 = RowParallelLinear(
+            config.projector_hidden_size,
+            config.text_config.hidden_size,
+            bias=config.projector_bias,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.linear_2",
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, image_features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = self.layer_norm(image_features)
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.reshape(-1, self.linear_1.input_size)
+        hidden_states, _ = self.linear_1(hidden_states)
+        hidden_states, _ = self.linear_2(self.act(hidden_states))
+        return hidden_states
+
+
+class Lfm3VlProcessingInfo(Qwen3VLProcessingInfo):
+    def get_hf_config(self) -> Lfm3VlConfig:
+        return self.ctx.get_hf_config(Lfm3VlConfig)
+
+    def get_hf_processor(self, **kwargs: object) -> Lfm3VlProcessor:
+        return self.ctx.get_hf_processor(Lfm3VlProcessor, **kwargs)
+
+
+class Lfm3VlDummyInputsBuilder(Qwen3VLDummyInputsBuilder):
+    def get_dummy_text(self, mm_counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> str:
+        image = "<|vision_start|><|image|><|vision_end|>"
+        video = "<|vision_start|><|video|><|vision_end|>"
+        return image * mm_counts.get("image", 0) + video * mm_counts.get("video", 0)
+
+
+@MULTIMODAL_REGISTRY.register_processor(
+    Qwen3VLMultiModalProcessor,
+    info=Lfm3VlProcessingInfo,
+    dummy_inputs=Lfm3VlDummyInputsBuilder,
+)
+class Lfm3VlForConditionalGeneration(
+    nn.Module, HasInnerState, IsHybrid, SupportsMultiModal, SupportsPP
+):
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_prefix={
+            "model.language_model.": "language_model.model.",
+            "model.vision_tower.": "vision_tower.",
+            "model.multi_modal_projector.": "multi_modal_projector.",
+            "lm_head.": "language_model.lm_head.",
+        }
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_placeholder_str(cls, modality: str, i: int) -> str | None:
+        if modality.startswith("image"):
+            return "<|vision_start|><|image|><|vision_end|>"
+        if modality.startswith("video"):
+            return "<|vision_start|><|video|><|vision_end|>"
+        raise ValueError("Only image or video modality is supported")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_mamba_state_dtype_from_config(
+        cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig
+    ) -> tuple[torch.dtype, ...]:
+        return _short_conv_state_dtype(vllm_config)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_mamba_state_shape_from_config(
+        cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[int, int]]:
+        return _short_conv_state_shape(
+            vllm_config, vllm_config.model_config.hf_config.text_config
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_mamba_state_copy_func(cls) -> tuple[MambaStateCopyFunc]:
+        return MambaStateCopyFuncCalculator.short_conv_state_copy_func()
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config: Lfm3VlConfig = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.config = config
+        with self._mark_tower_model(vllm_config, {"image", "video"}):
+            self.vision_tower = Lfm3VlVisionModel(
+                config.vision_config,
+                quant_config=vllm_config.quant_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "vision_tower"),
+            )
+            self.multi_modal_projector = Lfm3VlMultiModalProjector(
+                config,
+                quant_config=vllm_config.quant_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "multi_modal_projector"),
+            )
+        with self._mark_language_model(vllm_config):
+            self.language_model = init_vllm_registered_model(
+                vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                hf_config=config.text_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "language_model"),
+                architectures=["Lfm3ForCausalLM"],
+            )
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = (
+            self.language_model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors
+        )
+
+    def embed_multimodal(self, **kwargs: object) -> MultiModalEmbeddings:
+        merge = self.vision_tower.spatial_merge_size**2
+        embeddings: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        for pixels_key, grid_key, embeds_key in (
+            ("pixel_values", "image_grid_thw", "image_embeds"),
+            ("pixel_values_videos", "video_grid_thw", "video_embeds"),
+        ):
+            grid = kwargs.get(grid_key)
+            if (pixels := kwargs.get(pixels_key)) is not None:
+                assert isinstance(pixels, torch.Tensor)
+                assert isinstance(grid, torch.Tensor)
+                grid_thw = grid.tolist()
+                features = self.multi_modal_projector(
+                    self.vision_tower(pixels, grid_thw)
+                )
+                embeddings += features.split(
+                    [t * h * w // merge for t, h, w in grid_thw]
+                )
+            elif (embeds := kwargs.get(embeds_key)) is not None:
+                assert isinstance(embeds, torch.Tensor)
+                assert isinstance(grid, torch.Tensor)
+                embeddings += embeds.split((grid.prod(-1) // merge).tolist())
+        return embeddings
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | IntermediateTensors:
+        if intermediate_tensors is not None:
+            inputs_embeds = None
+        return self.language_model(
+            input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds
+        )
+
+    def compute_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.language_model.compute_logits(hidden_states)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        return loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+from typing import Any
+
+from transformers.configuration_utils import PreTrainedConfig
+
+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.lfm3 import Lfm3Config
+
+
+class Lfm3VlVisionConfig(PreTrainedConfig):
+    model_type = "lfm3_vl_vision"
+    base_config_key = "vision_config"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int = 1024,
+        intermediate_size: int = 2560,
+        num_hidden_layers: int = 14,
+        num_attention_heads: int = 16,
+        num_key_value_heads: int = 8,
+        layer_types: list[str] | None = None,
+        patch_size: int = 16,
+        temporal_patch_size: int = 2,
+        in_channels: int = 3,
+        spatial_merge_size: int = 2,
+        conv_kernel_size: int = 3,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-5,
+        initializer_range: float = 0.02,
+        rope_parameters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.intermediate_size = intermediate_size
+        self.num_hidden_layers = num_hidden_layers
+        self.num_attention_heads = num_attention_heads
+        self.num_key_value_heads = num_key_value_heads
+        self.layer_types = layer_types or [
+            "conv" if i < 2 or i % 2 else "full_attention"
+            for i in range(num_hidden_layers)
+        ]
+        self.patch_size = patch_size
+        self.temporal_patch_size = temporal_patch_size
+        self.in_channels = in_channels
+        self.spatial_merge_size = spatial_merge_size
+        self.conv_kernel_size = conv_kernel_size
+        self.norm_eps = norm_eps
+        self.initializer_range = initializer_range
+        self.rope_parameters = rope_parameters or {
+            "rope_type": "axial",
+            "rope_theta": 1_000_000.0,
+        }
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+
+class Lfm3VlConfig(PreTrainedConfig):
+    model_type = "lfm3_vl"
+    sub_configs = {"text_config": Lfm3Config, "vision_config": Lfm3VlVisionConfig}
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vision_config: dict | Lfm3VlVisionConfig | None = None,
+        text_config: dict | Lfm3Config | None = None,
+        image_token_id: int = 125_030,
+        video_token_id: int = 125_029,
+        vision_start_token_id: int = 125_009,
+        vision_end_token_id: int = 125_010,
+        projector_hidden_act: str = "gelu",
+        projector_hidden_size: int = 4096,
+        projector_bias: bool = True,
+        tie_word_embeddings: bool = True,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        if vision_config is None:
+            vision_config = Lfm3VlVisionConfig()
+        elif isinstance(vision_config, dict):
+            vision_config = Lfm3VlVisionConfig(**vision_config)
+        self.vision_config: Lfm3VlVisionConfig = vision_config
+
+        if text_config is None:
+            text_config = Lfm3Config()
+        elif isinstance(text_config, dict):
+            text_config = Lfm3Config(**text_config)
+        self.text_config: Lfm3Config = text_config
+
+        self.image_token_id = image_token_id
+        self.video_token_id = video_token_id
+        self.vision_start_token_id = vision_start_token_id
+        self.vision_end_token_id = vision_end_token_id
+        self.projector_hidden_act = projector_hidden_act
+        self.projector_hidden_size = projector_hidden_size
+        self.projector_bias = projector_bias
+        super().__init__(tie_word_embeddings=tie_word_embeddings, **kwargs)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+from transformers.models.qwen2_vl import Qwen2VLImageProcessor
+from transformers.models.qwen3_vl import Qwen3VLProcessor, Qwen3VLVideoProcessor
+from transformers.processing_utils import ProcessingKwargs, ProcessorMixin
+
+
+class Lfm3VlProcessorKwargs(ProcessingKwargs, total=False):  # type: ignore[call-arg]
+    _defaults = {
+        "text_kwargs": {
+            "padding": False,
+            "return_token_type_ids": False,
+            "return_mm_token_type_ids": False,
+        },
+        "videos_kwargs": {"return_metadata": True},
+    }
+
+
+class Lfm3VlProcessor(Qwen3VLProcessor):
+    valid_processor_kwargs = Lfm3VlProcessorKwargs
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_pretrained(cls, pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs):
+        # The hub checkpoints point the sub-processors at remote code that wraps
+        # these stock classes; load them directly and reuse vLLM's tokenizer.
+        tokenizer = kwargs.pop("tokenizer", None)
+        if tokenizer is None:
+            tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
+                pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs
+            )
+        return cls(
+            image_processor=Qwen2VLImageProcessor.from_pretrained(
+                pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs
+            ),
+            tokenizer=tokenizer,
+            video_processor=Qwen3VLVideoProcessor.from_pretrained(
+                pretrained_model_name_or_path, **kwargs
+            ),
+        )
+
+    # Qwen3-VL's adds `mm_token_type_ids`, which LFM3-VL does not return
+    model_input_names = ProcessorMixin.model_input_names
+
+    def _process_videos(self, videos, **kwargs):
+        # The checkpoints set `return_metadata: false`, but the frame timestamps
+        # of the placeholder need the metadata.
+        kwargs["return_metadata"] = True
+        return super()._process_videos(videos, **kwargs)

+import contextlib

+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup,
+    pytest.mark.skipif(not hasattr(os, "fork"), reason="Requires POSIX process groups"),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("parent_exits", [False, True])
+def test_stop_cleans_up_server_process_group(parent_exits: bool):
+    """Sweep cleanup must terminate workers even if the server already exited."""
+    script = """
+import os
+import signal
+import socket
+import sys
+
+with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1]))) as connection:
+    if os.fork() == 0:
+        connection.sendall(b"R")
+        connection.recv(1)
+    elif sys.argv[2] == "True":
+        os._exit(1)
+    else:
+        signal.pause()
+"""
+    with socket.socket() as listener:
+        listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        listener.listen()
+        listener.settimeout(10)
+        server = ServerProcess(
+            [
+                sys.executable,
+                "-c",
+                script,
+                str(listener.getsockname()[1]),
+                str(parent_exits),
+            ],
+            [],
+            show_stdout=True,
+        )
+        try:
+            with server:
+                process = server._server_process
+                connection, _ = listener.accept()
+                with contextlib.closing(connection):
+                    connection.settimeout(10)
+                    assert connection.recv(1) == b"R"
+                    if parent_exits:
+                        assert process.wait(timeout=10) == 1
+                    server.stop()
+                    assert connection.recv(1) == b"", "Server worker is still alive"
+                    assert process.returncode is not None, "Server was not reaped"
+        finally:
+            # Keep failing regressions from leaking the deliberately orphaned worker.
+            if server._server_process.returncode is None:
+                with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
+                    os.killpg(server._server_process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                server._server_process.wait(timeout=10)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Load plan on tiny CPU models.
+
+Invariant, for these models (whose loaders set no module state): planning
+(after ``start_reload``, as the NCCL engine does at the first update) changes
+no registration, attribute, address or layout, and no
+bytes outside checkpoint tensors, and a direct reload that copies each
+name's boxes into its ``get_dest`` tensors (and sends fallbacks in full through
+``load_weights``) leaves every tensor byte for byte as a cold start on the same
+weights, at the same addresses, on the first update and on later ones that
+reuse the plan.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.distributed.weight_transfer.base import ParamMeta
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import (
+    MergedColumnParallelLinear,
+    QKVParallelLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizeMethodBase
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload import (
+    finish_reload,
+    load_planned,
+    plan_loads,
+    start_reload,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload.plan import LoadPlan, Region
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import replace_parameter
+
+_MODEL_CONFIG = SimpleNamespace(
+    word_embeddings_untied_by_checkpoint=False, quantization=None, dtype=torch.bfloat16
+)
+_CPU = torch.device("cpu")
+BF16 = torch.bfloat16
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _direct_mode(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_RELOAD_MODE", "direct")
+
+
+def _param(*shape, dtype=BF16, loader=None) -> torch.nn.Parameter:
+    p = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(shape, dtype=dtype), requires_grad=False)
+    if loader is not None:
+        p.weight_loader = loader
+    return p
+
+
+class _Toy(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Loads ``name`` through its parameter's ``weight_loader`` (or
+    ``default_weight_loader``); ``stacked`` maps checkpoint names to a fused
+    parameter and shard id, as models' ``stacked_params_mapping`` does."""
+
+    stacked: dict[str, tuple[str, object]] = {}
+    skipped: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights):
+        params = dict(self.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False))
+        for name, weight in weights:
+            if name in self.skipped:
+                continue
+            if name in self.stacked:
+                target, shard = self.stacked[name]
+                param = params[target]
+                param.weight_loader(param, weight, shard)
+                continue
+            param = params[name]
+            getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)(param, weight)
+
+
+def _checkpoint(shapes: dict, seed: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    return {
+        name: torch.randn(shape, generator=gen).to(dtype)
+        for name, (shape, dtype) in shapes.items()
+    }
+
+
+def _metadata(shapes: dict) -> list[ParamMeta]:
+    return [ParamMeta(n, dtype, tuple(shape)) for n, (shape, dtype) in shapes.items()]
+
+
+def _cold_start(make, weights):
+    model = make()
+    model.load_weights(weights.items())
+    process_weights_after_loading(model, _MODEL_CONFIG, _CPU)
+    return model
+
+
+def _planned_reload(model, plan: LoadPlan, weights) -> None:
+    """What an engine does after ``start_reload``: boxes into their
+    destinations, fallbacks in full, in batches of two as a packed transfer
+    hands them over."""
+    items = list(weights.items())
+    for i in range(0, len(items), 2):
+        load_planned(model, plan, items[i : i + 2])
+    finish_reload(model, _MODEL_CONFIG, _CPU)
+
+
+def _state(model):
+    return {
+        name: (t.dtype, tuple(t.shape), t.stride(), t.detach().clone(), t.data_ptr())
+        for name, t in [*model.named_parameters(), *model.named_buffers()]
+    }
+
+
+def _registrations(model):
+    """Every registered tensor object and every module attribute."""
+    return {
+        name: (
+            {k: id(v) for k, v in m._parameters.items()},
+            {k: id(v) for k, v in m._buffers.items()},
+            {k: id(v) for k, v in vars(m).items()},
+        )
+        for name, m in model.named_modules()
+    }
+
+
+def _plan(model, shapes, mirrors=()) -> LoadPlan:
+    """``plan_loads`` (after ``start_reload``), checking that planning changed
+    no registration, module attribute, address or layout, and no bytes but
+    those of checkpoint tensors (the bake runs loaders' constant writes and
+    reads of their destination for real) and of ``mirrors``: other tensors a
+    fallback's loader writes from its destination."""
+    state, registrations = _state(model), _registrations(model)
+    plan = plan_loads(model, _metadata(shapes))
+    assert _registrations(model) == registrations
+    for name, t in [*model.named_parameters(), *model.named_buffers()]:
+        dtype, shape, stride, data, ptr = state[name]
+        assert (t.dtype, tuple(t.shape), t.stride(), t.data_ptr()) == (
+            dtype,
+            shape,
+            stride,
+            ptr,
+        ), name
+        if not hasattr(t, "_ckpt") and name not in mirrors:
+            assert torch.equal(t.view(torch.uint8), data.view(torch.uint8)), name

+def _check_plan_equals_cold_start(make, shapes, mirrors=()):
+    """Plan at the first update's start; that update and a second one reusing
+    the plan, with new random weights, must each equal a cold start on them,
+    byte for byte, and keep every address."""
+    model = _cold_start(make, _checkpoint(shapes, seed=0))
+    ptrs = {n: s[4] for n, s in _state(model).items()}
+    start_reload(model)
+    plan = _plan(model, shapes, mirrors)
+    for seed in (1, 2):
+        if seed > 1:
+            start_reload(model)
+        new = _checkpoint(shapes, seed=seed)
+        _planned_reload(model, plan, new)
+        actual, expected = _state(model), _state(_cold_start(make, new))
+        assert actual.keys() == expected.keys()
+        for name, (dtype, shape, stride, data, ptr) in actual.items():
+            assert (dtype, shape, stride) == expected[name][:3], name
+            assert torch.equal(
+                data.view(torch.uint8), expected[name][3].view(torch.uint8)
+            )
+            assert ptr == ptrs[name], f"{name} moved"
+    return model, plan
+
+
+def _offset(dest: torch.Tensor, param: torch.Tensor) -> int:
+    """Where ``dest`` starts in ``param``'s storage, relative to ``param``."""
+    return dest.storage_offset() - param.storage_offset()

+def _experts_model(ep_rank: int, ep_size: int, tp_rank: int, tp_size: int):
+    """``experts.gate_up_proj`` [E, 2I, H] and ``experts.down_proj`` [E, H, I]
+    (transformers v5), loaded one expert at a time as RoutedExperts does."""
+    local = range(ep_rank * _E // ep_size, (ep_rank + 1) * _E // ep_size)
+    i_shard = _I // tp_size

+    def w13_loader(param, loaded, shard_id=None):
+        for j, e in enumerate(local):
+            for half in (0, 1):  # gate rows, then up rows
+                rows = loaded[e].narrow(0, half * _I + tp_rank * i_shard, i_shard)
+                param[j].narrow(0, half * i_shard, i_shard).copy_(rows)

+    def w2_loader(param, loaded, shard_id=None):
+        for j, e in enumerate(local):
+            param[j].copy_(loaded[e].narrow(1, tp_rank * i_shard, i_shard))

+        model.experts.w13_weight = _param(

+        model.stacked = {
+            "experts.gate_up_proj": ("experts.w13_weight", None),
+            "experts.down_proj": ("experts.w2_weight", None),
+        }

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The load plan's bake: run ``load_weights`` once over ``TraceTensor``s, on
+the model's real tensors as ``begin_direct_reload`` left them, and record each
+``copy_`` from a trace and every reason a name cannot be written directly.
+
+A trace has no data, so nothing it feeds reaches memory: its ``copy_`` is
+recorded, and any other op on it runs on meta copies of its arguments. Ops on
+real tensors alone run for real: ``_TargetGuard`` makes a loader that reads a
+checkpoint tensor a fallback, and constant writes into one (``fill_``,
+``zero_``) happen, mid-update, and stay out of the plan (post-load processing
+owns padding)."""
+
+from collections import defaultdict
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, NoReturn
+
+import torch
+from torch.utils import _pytree as pytree
+from torch.utils._python_dispatch import TorchDispatchMode
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+
+from .direct import loadable_tensors
+from .trace import TraceTensor
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.distributed.weight_transfer.base import ParamMeta
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+_META = torch.device("meta")
+
+
+# ---- targets
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Target:
+    """A checkpoint tensor, as a write destination."""
+
+    module: str
+    tensor: str
+    real: torch.Tensor
+    byte_offset: int  # in its storage, as `begin_direct_reload` viewed it
+
+
+class Targets:
+    """Every checkpoint tensor in the layout ``begin_direct_reload`` applied,
+    by storage and by name. Writes name their tensor, for readable plans and
+    tests; ``by_name`` looks it up."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model: torch.nn.Module):
+        self.by_storage: dict[int, Target] = {}
+        self.by_name: dict[tuple[str, str], Target] = {}
+        for name, t in loadable_tensors(model):
+            if hasattr(t, "_ckpt"):
+                module, _, key = name.rpartition(".")
+                target = Target(module, key, t, t.storage_offset() * t.dtype.itemsize)
+                # writes into a storage are labelled with its first target
+                self.by_storage.setdefault(t.untyped_storage()._cdata, target)
+                self.by_name[(module, key)] = target
+
+
+def _storage_key(t: torch.Tensor) -> int | None:
+    return None if isinstance(t, TraceTensor) else t.untyped_storage()._cdata
+
+
+# ---- the sink
+
+
+class _BakeStopped(Exception):
+    """A loader needs a traced tensor's values, or an op on it fails on meta:
+    the loader cannot continue. ``name`` is the trace's name."""
+
+    def __init__(self, name: str):
+        super().__init__(name)
+        self.name = name
+
+
+class _SinkClosed(RuntimeError):
+    """A trace was used after its bake ended."""
+
+
+_VALUE_READ = "its loader reads tensor values (.item(), bool(), ...)"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Copy:
+    """One ``dest.copy_(src)`` from a trace."""
+
+    src: TraceTensor
+    storage: int  # destination storage key
+    byte_offset: int
+    shape: tuple[int, ...]
+    stride: tuple[int, ...]
+    dtype: torch.dtype
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _PlanSink:
+    """One bake's record. Traces call ``accept_copy`` for a ``copy_`` from
+    them, ``unsupported`` for any other op outside ``VIEW_OPS`` and
+    ``value_read`` for ``.item()`` and the like; it turns these into copies,
+    fallbacks and bake stops."""
+
+    targets: Targets
+    copies: dict[str, list[Copy]] = field(default_factory=lambda: defaultdict(list))
+    fallback: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    # Names that stopped their loader, and why. Kept even though these also
+    # raise: a loader may catch the exception and carry on, and the name must
+    # still fall back.
+    stops: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    wrote: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)  # copied anywhere
+    last_writer: dict[int, str] = field(default_factory=dict)  # per storage
+    # The name last handed to load_weights, or last copied from. A loader that
+    # reads ahead (as AutoWeightsLoader's groupby does) makes this the next
+    # name; it is used only to blame a destination read that no copy_ preceded.
+    current: str | None = None
+    # Set when the bake ends: a trace a loader kept on the module must not be
+    # used again (by a later load_weights), or its writes would go nowhere.
+    closed: bool = False
+
+    def mark(self, name: str, reason: str) -> None:
+        self.fallback.setdefault(name, reason)
+
+    def _check_open(self, trace: TraceTensor) -> None:
+        if self.closed:
+            raise _SinkClosed(
+                f"load plan: a planning trace of {trace._name!r} was used after "
+                "planning; a loader keeps an incoming tensor across load_weights "
+                "calls, which the load plan does not support"
+            )
+
+    def accept_copy(self, dest: torch.Tensor, src: TraceTensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        self._check_open(src)
+        name = src._name
+        self.current = name
+        self.wrote.add(name)
+        key = dest.untyped_storage()._cdata  # dest is never a trace
+        self.last_writer[key] = name
+        self.copies[name].append(
+            Copy(
+                src=src,
+                storage=key,
+                byte_offset=dest.storage_offset() * dest.dtype.itemsize,
+                shape=tuple(dest.shape),
+                stride=tuple(dest.stride()),
+                dtype=dest.dtype,
+            )
+        )
+        return dest
+
+    def value_read(self, trace: TraceTensor) -> NoReturn:
+        self._check_open(trace)
+        self.stops.setdefault(trace._name, _VALUE_READ)
+        raise _BakeStopped(trace._name)
+
+    def unsupported(
+        self, func: Callable, args: tuple, kwargs: dict, traces: list[TraceTensor]
+    ) -> Any:
+        """Mark the names fallbacks and run ``func`` on meta copies of its
+        arguments, so it writes no real tensor; tensor results become traces
+        of the first name, with no geometry."""
+        self._check_open(traces[0])
+        if _writes_a_real_tensor(func, args, kwargs):  # in place, or out=
+            reason = f"writes it without Tensor.copy_ ({func.__name__})"
+            self.wrote.update(t._name for t in traces)
+        else:
+            reason = f"applies {func.__name__} to it"
+        for t in traces:
+            self.mark(t._name, reason)
+
+        def to_meta(a: Any) -> Any:
+            if isinstance(a, TraceTensor):
+                return torch.empty_strided(
+                    a.shape, a.stride(), dtype=a.dtype, device=_META
+                )
+            return a.to(_META) if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor) else a
+
+        first = traces[0]
+        flat, spec = pytree.tree_flatten((args, kwargs))
+        meta_flat = [to_meta(a) for a in flat]
+        meta_args, meta_kwargs = pytree.tree_unflatten(meta_flat, spec)
+        try:
+            out = func(*meta_args, **meta_kwargs)
+        except Exception as e:  # no meta kernel, a shape error, ...
+            # the error stays out of the reason, which groups the report
+            logger.debug("load plan: %s on %s fails on meta: %r", func, first._name, e)
+            self.stops.setdefault(first._name, f"{func.__name__} fails on meta")
+            raise _BakeStopped(first._name) from e
+        originals = {id(m): a for m, a in zip(meta_flat, flat)}
+
+        def wrap(o: Any) -> Any:
+            if not isinstance(o, torch.Tensor):
+                return o
+            if id(o) in originals:  # in place: return the original argument
+                return originals[id(o)]
+            return TraceTensor(first._name, o.shape, o.dtype, self, None, reason)
+
+        return pytree.tree_map(wrap, out)
+
+
+def _writes_a_real_tensor(func: Any, args: tuple, kwargs: dict) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``func`` writes an argument that is not a trace (in place or
+    through ``out=``)."""
+    schema = getattr(func, "_schema", None)
+    for i, arg in enumerate(getattr(schema, "arguments", ())):
+        if arg.alias_info is None or not arg.alias_info.is_write:
+            continue
+        value = args[i] if i < len(args) else kwargs.get(arg.name)
+        leaves = pytree.tree_leaves(value)
+        if any(isinstance(t, torch.Tensor) for t in leaves) and not any(
+            isinstance(t, TraceTensor) for t in leaves
+        ):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+# Ops on a target that read only its metadata.
+_METADATA_OPS = {
+    torch.ops.aten.empty_like,
+    torch.ops.aten.zeros_like,
+    torch.ops.aten.ones_like,
+    torch.ops.aten.full_like,
+    torch.ops.aten.new_empty,
+    torch.ops.aten.new_empty_strided,
+    torch.ops.aten.new_zeros,
+    torch.ops.aten.new_ones,
+    torch.ops.aten.new_full,
+}
+# Writes into a target that do not read it: constants, or copies of tensors
+# that are not checkpoint tensors. They run, and stay out of the plan:
+# post-load processing owns padding.
+_CONSTANT_WRITES = {
+    torch.ops.aten.copy_,
+    torch.ops.aten.fill_,
+    torch.ops.aten.zero_,
+    torch.ops.aten.index_put_,
+}
+
+
+class _TargetGuard(TorchDispatchMode):
+    """Ops on real tensors alone run for real. One that reads a checkpoint
+    tensor (not a view, not only its metadata) makes the last name written
+    into that storage (or the name being loaded) a fallback: the direct path
+    would skip it. For example ``composed_weight_loader``'s
+    ``param.copy_(fn(param))``, a check such as ``torch.equal(param, x)``, or
+    a mirror copied from ``param``. Reads that bypass the dispatcher
+    (``tolist()`` or ``numpy()`` of a CPU tensor, a raw kernel launch) go
+    unseen."""
+
+    def __init__(self, sink: _PlanSink):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.sink = sink
+
+    def __torch_dispatch__(self, func, types, args=(), kwargs=None):
+        kwargs = kwargs or {}
+        packet = func.overloadpacket
+        leaves = [
+            a
+            for a in pytree.arg_tree_leaves(*args, **kwargs)
+            if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor)
+        ]
+        if any(isinstance(a, TraceTensor) for a in leaves):
+            return func(*args, **kwargs)  # the trace's own handler
+        if not func.is_view and packet not in _METADATA_OPS:
+            # copy_(target, x) and friends write the target but read only x
+            read = args[1:] if packet in _CONSTANT_WRITES else args
+            self._check_reads(packet, pytree.arg_tree_leaves(*read, **kwargs))
+        return func(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    def _check_reads(self, packet: Any, leaves: list) -> None:
+        for a in leaves:
+            key = _storage_key(a) if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor) else None
+            if key is not None and key in self.sink.targets.by_storage:
+                name = self.sink.last_writer.get(key, self.sink.current)
+                if name is not None:
+                    self.sink.mark(name, f"its loader reads the destination ({packet})")
+                return
+
+
+# ---- the bake
+
+
+def _bake(
+    model: torch.nn.Module, metas: dict[str, "ParamMeta"], targets: Targets
+) -> _PlanSink:
+    """Trace ``load_weights`` over every name, in one pass. A name that stops
+    the loader (a value read, an op that fails on meta) unwinds the model's
+    ``load_weights``; it falls back, and ``load_weights`` is called again
+    with the names after it, on the same sink. Loaders handle each name as it
+    arrives, so nothing is replayed.
+    Module state a loader sets stays: it is what that loader would leave on
+    the ``load_weights`` path."""
+    sink = _PlanSink(targets)
+    names = list(metas)
+
+    def weights(rest: list[str]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        for name in rest:
+            meta = metas[name]
+            sink.current = name
+            shape = torch.Size(meta.shape)
+            yield name, TraceTensor.checkpoint(name, shape, meta.dtype, sink)
+
+    start = 0
+    try:
+        with torch.no_grad(), _TargetGuard(sink):
+            while start < len(names):
+                try:
+                    model.load_weights(weights(names[start:]))
+                    break
+                except _BakeStopped as stop:
+                    # Resume after the name that stopped (not after the last
+                    # name yielded: a loader may have read ahead).
+                    at = names.index(stop.name)
+                    if at < start:
+                        raise RuntimeError(
+                            f"load plan: a loader reads the values of "
+                            f"{stop.name!r} after later names arrived (it keeps "
+                            "an incoming tensor across names)"
+                        ) from stop
+                    start = at + 1
+    finally:
+        sink.closed = True
+    return sink
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Traced:
+    copies: dict[str, list[Copy]]  # per name
+    reasons: dict[str, str]  # fallback names and why
+    lonely: list[str]  # fallbacks that wrote nothing
+
+
+def trace_loads(
+    model: torch.nn.Module, metas: dict[str, "ParamMeta"], targets: Targets
+) -> Traced:
+    """Bake all names (see ``_bake``). A name that stopped the loader falls
+    back; what it recorded before stopping is dropped."""
+    try:
+        sink = _bake(model, metas, targets)
+    except Exception as e:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"load plan: tracing load_weights failed: {e!r}") from e
+    reasons = dict(sink.stops)
+    for name in reasons:
+        sink.copies.pop(name, None)
+    lonely = [n for n in sink.fallback if n not in sink.wrote and n not in reasons]
+    for name, reason in sink.fallback.items():
+        reasons.setdefault(name, reason)
+    return Traced(sink.copies, reasons, lonely)
